meta.name: claude-handoff
meta.description: Hand the current conversation off to a fresh background agent that picks up the work immediately.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话转交给新后台代理继续处理
copy.tagline_en: Hand off the current conversation to a fresh background agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to seamlessly transfer a conversation to another agent

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成当前对话的摘要，并启动一个后台新代理继续工作。摘要包含建议调用的技能，并引用已有文档。
howto.when: 当你需要将当前任务交给一个新代理继续处理时，可以要求 Claude 执行交接。

say.text: 把当前对话交接给一个新代理，继续修复登录 bug。
say.note: Claude 会生成摘要并启动后台代理。

say.text: 请将讨论内容转给后台代理，继续完成架构设计。
say.note: 新代理会基于摘要继续工作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a handoff summary of the current conversation and launches a background agent to continue the work. The summary includes suggested skills and references existing documents.
howto.when_en: When you need to hand off the current task to a new agent to continue, you can ask Claude to perform the handoff.

say_en.text: Hand off this conversation to a new agent to continue fixing the login bug.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a summary and launch a background agent.

say_en.text: Please transfer the discussion to a background agent to continue the architecture design.
say_en.note: The new agent will continue based on the summary.
